title: Triple H vs Cactus Jack
result: Triple H def. Cactus Jack (retained WWF Title)
hook: Mick Foley dragged the corporate Triple H into a war of thumbtacks, a barbed-wire board, and a fall off the entrance stage. The night Triple H proved he would give his body for a main event.

title: Triple H vs Stone Cold Steve Austin
result: Triple H def. Austin, 2 falls to 1
hook: Two of the toughest of their generation across three falls: a straight match, a street fight, and a steel cage. Nearly forty minutes of two men beating each other into the canvas with everything the rules allowed.

title: Triple H vs Shawn Michaels
result: Michaels def. Triple H
hook: Shawn Michaels had not wrestled in over four years and a broken back was supposed to have ended him. His best friend turned on him, and the two settled it in an unsanctioned street fight of ladders, chairs, and history.

title: Shawn Michaels vs Razor Ramon
result: Razor Ramon def. Michaels (unified the Intercontinental Title)
hook: The ladder match that invented the genre. Two Intercontinental Titles hung above the ring and two men threw themselves off the top rung to reach them. Every ladder spot for the next thirty years traces back to this night.

title: Shawn Michaels vs Mankind
result: Michaels retained the WWF Championship
hook: A boyhood-dream champion against a deranged newcomer who felt no pain. Michaels and Mankind turned a title defense into a psychological horror match critics still cite as one of the most influential of the decade.

title: Shawn Michaels vs Razor Ramon
result: Michaels def. Razor Ramon (retained Intercontinental Title)
hook: The rematch that had no business being as good as the original, and somehow was. Michaels and Ramon climbed the ladder again a year later and topped their WrestleMania classic with bigger, more dangerous bumps.

title: Kurt Angle vs Chris Benoit
result: Angle retained the WWE Title

result: Benoit won (submitted Triple H)

title: The Rock vs Triple H
result: Triple H won the WWF Title 6–5 (Rock DQ’d on the Undertaker’s return)
hook: Sixty minutes, twelve falls — Triple H edged The Rock 6–5 to reclaim the WWF Title, sealed when a returning Undertaker stormed the ring and got Rock disqualified for the final fall.

title: The Rock vs Chris Jericho
result: Jericho won the WCW Championship — his first world title
hook: Chris Jericho beat The Rock to win the WCW Championship — the first world title of his career, a milestone on his road to becoming the first Undisputed Champion.

title: The Rock vs Stone Cold Steve Austin
result: The Rock finally beat Austin at WrestleMania — Austin’s last match
hook: Their third and final WrestleMania meeting — and the only one The Rock won, hitting three Rock Bottoms to beat Austin in what turned out to be Stone Cold’s last match.

title: The Rock vs Hollywood Hulk Hogan
result: The Rock won Icon vs Icon in a legendary atmosphere
hook: Icon vs Icon — two generations collide as a red-hot Toronto crowd hijacks the match for Hogan. The Rock won, then the post-match respect turned into an all-time WrestleMania moment.

title: The Rock vs Mankind
result: The Rock won the WWF Title via a pre-recorded ‘I Quit’
hook: The brutal ‘I Quit’ match immortalised in Beyond the Mat — eleven unprotected chair shots, and a Rock win sealed by a pre-recorded tape of Mankind saying ‘I quit.’
